checks.name: Missing values
checks.recommendation: Impute or drop missing cells; if missingness is informative, encode it explicitly.

checks.name: Constant / near-constant columns
checks.recommendation: Drop constant columns; they carry no signal and inflate dimensionality.

checks.name: Exact duplicate rows
checks.recommendation: De-duplicate before splitting, otherwise identical rows leak across folds.

checks.name: Duplicate rows with conflicting labels
checks.recommendation: Resolve conflicting labels (relabel or drop); they cap achievable accuracy.

checks.name: Class imbalance
checks.recommendation: Use stratified splits and class weights; report balanced accuracy and per-class recall.

checks.name: Suspected label noise
checks.recommendation: Audit the flagged samples; relabel or remove confidently mislabelled points.

checks.name: Train/test leakage
checks.recommendation: Re-split after de-duplication and remove target-derived features.

checks.name: Outliers (IQR / robust z / Isolation Forest)
checks.recommendation: Inspect flagged rows; winsorise or use models robust to heavy tails.

checks.name: Covariate shift (adversarial validation)
checks.recommendation: Check collection or time period; consider importance weighting or domain adaptation.

checks.name: Feature redundancy
checks.recommendation: Remove or combine highly correlated features to reduce variance and cost.

checks.name: Low-information features
checks.recommendation: Confirm with multivariate importance before dropping; univariate filters miss interactions.

checks.name: Sample-size adequacy
checks.recommendation: Collect more data (especially minority classes) or reduce dimensionality/regularise.
